description: The source is substantive but describes a conventional intercity railway rather than an urban-rail system.

candidates.title: Conventional railway installs new overhead-line monitoring equipment
candidates.search_snippet: An intercity railway installed overhead-line monitoring equipment on a conventional rail corridor.
candidates.source_content: Synthetic railway technical release. An intercity conventional railway installed overhead-line monitoring equipment on a long-distance corridor. The release explains the equipment, installation, and monitoring results; no metro, MRT, subway, light rail, tram, AGT, monorail, or people-mover context is present.
